referenceFunction.generalComment: The data set represents the fiber optic fixed network in Switzerland; UUID: c4905e85-a62a-3f9c-b41b-60dc1707453f
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset represents the optic fibre network in Switzerland. The reference year for network traffic is 2014. The equipment is based on information from 2010 but is deemed the most actual. A lifetime of 6 years is assumed. Amount of electricity consumed is based on the network electricity intensity (kWh/GB) information from the Telefonica Access Network.. The functional unit = 1 GB.
